title: Developer Philosophy
summary: Covers debt management to avoid ground-up rewrites, the 90/90 rule for time budgeting, testable code with minimal side effects, and modular architecture as a middle ground between microservices and monoliths.
when-to-read: Read when deciding how to manage technical debt, budget time on a project, or choose an architecture style for a new system or feature. Do not read for a single named architecture pattern's mechanics (see building-modern-architectures) — this is broad engineering philosophy, not one specific pattern.
